newsitem.title: LITHUANIA: LITHUANIA-MAZHEIKIU REFINES 3.4 MLN TONNES JAN-JULY.
newsitem.headline: LITHUANIA-MAZHEIKIU REFINES 3.4 MLN TONNES JAN-JULY.

text.p: Lithuania's Mazeikiu oil refinery said on Wednesday it processed 3.4 million tonnes of oil and products in January through July versus 2.1 million tonnes in the same period last year.

Mazeikiu said 2.2 million tonnes of its January-through-July production this year came from its own feed stock and 1.3 million tonnes came from other companies', compared to 399,000 tonnes of its own feed stock in the same period last year.

"In November last year we received our first credit for working capital, $19 million, from Merrill Lynch, and in February we received $40 million from CS First Boston," Mazeikiu deputy finance director Leonas Garbenas told Reuters.
"We have increased our own production and of course our profitability went up," Garbenas added.
Mazeikiu reported a 17.7 million litas profit for the first half of 1997, compared to a 56.4 million litas loss in the same period last year and total 1996 loss of 17.8 million litas.
Garbenas said Mazeikiu was returning $9.5 million of its loans on Wednesday, and the rest in September, and expected to hold talks with CF First Boston next week on another $59 million credit.
Crude oil accounted for the largest part of Mazeikiu's overall January-through-July production this year, totaling 2.9 million tonnes.
Heavy heating oil was next, totaling 373,598 million tonnes.
